Built In, Not Bolted On

Every home is powered for the future.

Solar Energy System

State-of-the-art rooftop solar comes pre-installed on every home, sized to offset day-to-day energy use.

Battery Storage

Stored solar power keeps the lights on and the fridge running, day or night.

Smart Electrical Panel

An intelligent panel automatically manages backup power, keeping essential circuits live during outages.

EV Charger, Prewired

An electric vehicle charger is built into the garage — no aftermarket install, no waiting.

Signal Hill, California

An enclave above Long Beach, minutes from everything.

Hilltop Park

Views for miles

A short walk up the hill, Hilltop Park looks out over Long Beach, downtown LA, the coastline, and Catalina Island on a clear day.

Location

3 miles to the coast

Signal Hill sits between Long Beach and California Heights, about 3 miles from the beach and 4 miles from downtown Long Beach.

Commute

On the 405

Direct access to the 405, with the 710 and 605 freeways nearby — roughly 20 miles to LAX and 30 miles to downtown LA.

Schools

Distinguished district

Signal Hill Elementary and Nelson Academy are California Distinguished Schools; Woodrow Wilson High School carries an A rating nearby.

Parks & Trails

Built for walking

Eight city parks and a network of pedestrian trails wind through Signal Hill, including Discovery Well Park's courts and playgrounds.

Everyday Life

Shopping close by

Costco, Target, and Home Depot are minutes away, with the cafes and boutiques of California Heights just a block from the community.
